criteria.name: Latest Package Versions

criteria.reason: Uses DefaultAzureCredential, async/await, proper client construction, environment variable for vault URL

criteria.name: Error Handling

criteria.name: Code Quality

criteria.name: Client Constructor with Endpoint and Credential
criteria.reason: Correctly constructs SecretClient with new SecretClient(keyVaultUrl, credential)

criteria.name: Async/Await Pattern
criteria.reason: Uses async/await throughout, main() is async function, no .then() chains or callbacks

criteria.name: Pagination with for-await-of
criteria.reason: Not applicable - prompt does not require list/query operations

criteria.name: LRO Pattern (beginXxx + pollUntilDone)
criteria.reason: Correctly uses beginDeleteSecret() and awaits pollUntilDone() before purging

criteria.name: RestError Exception Handling
criteria.reason: Checks error.statusCode which works for RestError, but does not explicitly import or type-check RestError from @azure/core-rest-pipeline

criteria.name: No Deprecated Packages
criteria.reason: Only uses current @azure/* track packages, no legacy azure-storage or ms-rest-* packages

criteria.name: Logging via @azure/logger
criteria.reason: @azure/logger is not imported or used. No setLogLevel() or AZURE_LOG_LEVEL configuration

criteria.name: package.json with Correct Dependencies
criteria.reason: Valid package.json with all required @azure/* dependencies, TypeScript, ts-node, and @types/node

criteria.name: Prompt: Installing required packages
criteria.reason: README and package.json clearly document @azure/keyvault-secrets and @azure/identity with installation instructions

criteria.name: Prompt: SecretClient with vault URL and credential
criteria.reason: Creates SecretClient correctly: new SecretClient(keyVaultUrl, credential)

criteria.name: Prompt: All CRUD methods present
criteria.reason: Implements all four: setSecret() for create/update, getSecret() for read, beginDeleteSecret() for delete, purgeDeletedSecret() for purge

criteria.name: Prompt: Awaiting DeleteSecretPoller
criteria.reason: Correctly awaits poller.pollUntilDone() before calling purgeDeletedSecret()

criteria.name: Prompt: Error handling for RestError
criteria.reason: Has error handling with statusCode checks but does not explicitly handle RestError type or import it
